question: NVIDIA System Software Engineer Internship (on-campus), online interview with three interviewers over a shared HackerRank link. Two of the questions: what is the difference between a `struct` and a `class`, and implement the `memcpy` function in C.
lookingFor: Knowing the exact language-level difference rather than folklore
Awareness of the overlap case and why memmove exists
Edge-case handling and attention to types
followUps: How would you speed memcpy up using 8-byte words and what alignment problems appear?
Implement memmove. Which direction do you copy and when?
Why is `memcpy` on overlapping buffers undefined, and what can go wrong in practice?
Can a struct have a virtual function? Does it change its size?
